title: Oopgeki chart
description: Hand-written chart file for Oopgeki. Loaded and validated by com.oopgeki.frontend.chart.ChartLoader. The schema is deliberately stricter than the loader in one respect: unknown fields are rejected here but silently ignored at runtime, so typos surface in the editor instead of at play time.

title.description: Display name shown in the chart menu. Must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

artist.description: Display name for the artist. Optional.

audio.description: Path to the audio file, relative to the assets root. Example: "audio/song.ogg".

bpm.description: Quarter-note beats per minute. Must be greater than 0. Constant for the whole chart in format version 1.

offset.description: Seconds into the audio at which beat 0 occurs. Must be >= 0. Omitting it means 0.

difficulty.description: Display name for the difficulty. Optional; not interpreted by the loader.

noteSpeed.description: Suggested note fall speed in pixels per second. Gameplay may override this.

bulletSpeed.description: Default bullet fall speed in pixels per second, used when a bullet omits "speed".

bulletDamage.description: Default damage, used when a bullet omits "damage".

notes.description: Note events. May be omitted; may not be null.

bullets.description: Bullet events. May be omitted; may not be null.

noteEvent.description: A note that must be hit as it reaches the hit line. Duplicate (beat, lane) pairs are rejected at load time.

beat.description: Beat at which the note reaches the hit line. Fractional values are allowed.

lane.description: LEFT is the S key; RIGHT is the D key.

bulletEvent.description: A bullet that falls straight down at a fixed horizontal position.

beat.description: Beat at which the bullet crosses the player's row (the danger line), not when it spawns.

x.description: Horizontal center in game coordinates. Fixed for the bullet's lifetime. Not validated against the screen width.

speed.description: Fall speed in pixels per second. Defaults to the chart's bulletSpeed.

damage.description: Damage on hit. Defaults to the chart's bulletDamage.
